title: Reported Bombing Of Residence Of Manager Of Mitsui Bussan Kaisha, Ltd. Untrue - Case Revealed To Be Attempted Armed Robbery At Another Residence

page_data.en:
July 29, 1941. 1006
29 7 41
Reported bombing of residence of manager of
Mitsui Bussan Kaisha, Ltd. untrue - case revealed
to be attempted armed robbery at another residence

According to information secured from the French
Police, the report by newspapers that a bomb was thrown by
some unknown persons at House 144 Route Pere Robert, the
residence of the manager of the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha, Ltd.,
yesterday is untrue. The case is learned to have been
an attempted armed robbery at Lane 17, House 5 Route Herve
de Sieyes.

It is ascertained that at about 8 a.m. July 28,
two desperadoes, under the guise of water-melon hawkers,
knocked at the door of House 5, Lane 17 Route Herve de
Sieyes, pretending to offer melons for sale. When the
door was opened by an inmate of the house, one of the
desperadoes picked out a hand-grenade from the melons and
intimidated the occupant of the house. Unexpectedly, the
occupant raised an alarm and the desperadoes decamped.

When they reached the corner of Route Pere
Robert, they were chased by a Russian policeman, who fired
several shots. The robber who was still holding the
hand-grenade threw it at the pursuing police, but the
missile failed to explode. In the meantime, an Annamite
policeman joined in the pursuit. The fleeing man was
finally shot in the head and collapsed. He was immediately
sent to St. Marie's Hospital for treatment but succumbed
shortly afterwards.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 30 JULY 1941）

1941年7月29日。1006
29 7 41
关于三井物产株式会社经理寓所遭炸弹袭击的报道不实——案情实为另处寓所发生的武装抢劫未遂案

根据从法租界警务处获得的情报，报纸上关于昨日有不明身份者向位于罗伯特长路（Route Pere Robert）144号的三井物产株式会社经理寓所投掷炸弹的报道并不属实。据悉，该案实为在赫维德西耶斯路（Route Herve de Sieyes）17弄5号发生的一起武装抢劫未遂案。

经查，1941年7月28日上午8时许，两名歹徒假扮成卖西瓜的小贩，敲开了赫维德西耶斯路17弄5号的大门，佯装兜售西瓜。当屋内一名住户开门时，其中一名歹徒从西瓜中取出一枚手榴弹，对屋内居住者进行恐吓。出乎意料的是，该住户发出警报，歹徒随即逃窜。

当他们逃至罗伯特长路拐角处时，遭到一名俄国巡捕的追捕，该巡捕开枪射击数发。仍手持手榴弹的那名劫匪将手榴弹掷向追赶的警察，但该投掷物并未爆炸。与此同时，一名安南籍巡捕也加入了追捕行列。逃跑者最终头部中枪倒地。他随即被送往圣玛丽医院（St. Marie's Hospital）救治，但不久后身亡。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1941年7月30日）

CHINA PRESS
JUL 30 1941
FMP Denies
Attempt On
Hanawa's Life

The Domei report that an attempt was made on the life of Mr. Hanawa, director of the Shanghai Branch of the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha, and member of the Shanghai Municipal Council, was discredited by the French Municipal Police, yesterday who said that it was purely coincidental that police clashed with bandits outside Mr. Hanawa's home, 114 Rue Pere Robert, at 8.30 a.m. Monday.
A Chinese bandits was shot and killed by members of the French Police outside Mr. Hanawa's home at 3.30 a.m. Monday. An official of the F.M.P. denied the Japanese report that a number of hand-grenades were thrown into Mr. Hanawa's home, and denied the bandits were terrorists as claimed by Japanese quarters.
The police version runs that several bandits entered a Chinese house in Route de Sieyes, and intimidated the inmates with a hand-grenade. The inmates however raised an alarm, and the bandits took to their heels. A Russian member of the F.M.P. who was on duty nearby answered the alarm and chased the bandits.
An Annamite policeman joined in the chase, and with his service pistol fatally wounded one of the fleeing robbers outside Mr. Hanawa's residence.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》（CHINA PRESS）
1941年7月30日
法租界警务处否认
针对花轮氏的
刺杀企图

共同社报道称，有人企图刺杀三井物产株式会社上海分社社长、上海公共租界工部局董事花轮（Hanawa）先生，法租界警务处于昨日驳斥了这一说法。法租界警务处表示，周一上午8时30分，警方在花轮先生位于罗伯特长路114号的寓所外与匪徒发生冲突纯属巧合。
周一凌晨3时30分，一名中国匪徒在花轮先生寓所外被法租界警务处警员击毙。法租界警务处一名官员否认了日方关于多枚手榴弹被投掷进花轮先生寓所的报道，并否认这些匪徒是日方所称的恐怖分子。
警方的说法是，几名匪徒进入西耶斯路（Route de Sieyes）的一处华人住宅，用手榴弹威胁屋内人员。然而，屋内人员发出了警报，匪徒们仓皇逃窜。附近执勤的一名法租界警务处俄籍警员听到警报后，对匪徒展开追捕。
一名安南籍巡捕加入追捕，并在花轮先生寓所外用配枪致命击伤了一名正在逃跑的劫匪。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY
2 -
French Police Deny
Report Of Attempt
On Y. Hanawa H're

A Japanese news agency re-
port today asserting that an
attempt was made yesterday
morning by Chinese terrorists
to assassinate Mr. Yutaro
Hanawa, head of the Mitsui
Bussan Kaisha and Japanese
member of the Shanghai
Municipal Council, was em-
phatically denied by the French
police. An official of the French
police stated that the shooting
which the news agency claimed
was an attempt on Mr. Hanawa's
life, was purely a police gun-
fight with armed robbers who
happened to pass by the Japa-
nese official's home at 114 Route
Fere Robert. The Japanese
news agency's report that hand-
grenades were thrown into Mr.
Hanawa's home by alleged ter-
rorists was also officially denied
by the French police.
page_data.zh:
《上海晚邮报与水星报》（SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY）
- 2 -
法国警方否认
有关企图刺杀
Y. 花轮先生的报道

一家日本通讯社今日发布报道，声称昨天上午中国恐怖分子企图刺杀三井物产株式会社社长、上海公共租界工部局日籍董事花轮由太郎（Yutaro Hanawa）先生，该报道遭到法国警方的强烈否认。法国警方一名官员表示，该通讯社声称是针对花轮先生生命的刺杀行动的枪击事件，纯粹是警方与武装劫匪之间的枪战，这些劫匪碰巧路过位于罗伯特长路114号的这位日本官员的寓所。法国警方也正式否认了日本通讯社关于所谓恐怖分子向花轮先生寓所投掷手榴弹的报道。
